summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filed by One & One Green Technologies, a Philippines-based recycler, announcing the schedule for its fiscal year 2025 financial results and an earnings call on April 28, 2026. It includes a press release with dial-in and webcast details, a request for investor questions, and standard forward-looking statements. The filing contains no mention of a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or abrupt management change. Accordingly, it is classified as 'None' and is routine earnings guidance.
